title: Tuesday at Grandma's
setting: Grandparents' small house: a little kitchen and a garden behind it.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Grandpa Joe
characters.look: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan)

characters.name: Grandma Rosa
characters.look: Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick)

sentences.en: Ben visits his grandparents every Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 本每个星期二早上都去看望祖父母。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) rings the doorbell of a small house in the morning sun; Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) and Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) open the door with smiles.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben visiting his grandparents in the morning; 'every Tuesday' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Grandpa Joe drinks black coffee in the little kitchen.
sentences.zh: 乔爷爷在小厨房里喝黑咖啡。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) sits in a small cosy kitchen holding a cup of black coffee.

sentences.en: Ben loves the smell of the coffee.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) closes his eyes and sniffs happily near the steaming coffee cup of Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan).

sentences.en: It is cold outside, but Ben wants to play.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) presses his face to the kitchen window, holding a ball; outside the garden is frosty and the trees are bare.

sentences.en: He puts on warm trousers and his shoes.
sentences.zh: 他穿上暖和的裤子和鞋子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sits on the floor by the door, pulling thick warm trousers on over his shorts, a pair of shoes beside him.

sentences.en: Grandma Rosa opens the wide garden gate for him.
sentences.zh: 罗莎奶奶为他打开宽大的花园门。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) swings open a wide wooden garden gate while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), now in warm trousers, runs out, frosty grass beyond.

sentences.en: Later, they eat pasta and sweet apple cake.
sentences.zh: 后来，他们吃意大利面和甜甜的苹果蛋糕。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) and Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) sit at the kitchen table with plates of pasta and an apple cake.
sentences.draw_note: Shows them eating pasta and apple cake; 'later' and 'sweet' can't be shown.

sentences.en: They all agree that nothing is better than pasta.
sentences.zh: 他们都同意，没有什么比意大利面更好吃了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) and Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) nod and smile at each other over empty pasta plates, giving a thumbs-up.
sentences.draw_note: Shows them happily nodding over empty pasta plates; the exact opinion can only be guessed.
